name: Automatic Crop Box Generation via Otsu Thresholding
definition: An algorithm to automatically compute a crop box by thresholding a coarse level, finding connected components, and projecting the bounding box to the target resolution.
summary: Automatic Crop Box Generation via Otsu Thresholding automatically computes a tight bounding box for 3D volumes by thresholding coarse data, distinguishing itself through global intensity separation rather than spatial clustering.
